title: University Friends Circle
description: Five university students connected through dorm life, classes, and shared activities. Rich in personal facts, hobbies, travel, and evolving relationships.

people.name: Alice Chen
people.profile: Practical, organized, loves outdoor activities. Grew up in Portland. Parents run a Chinese restaurant.

observations.text: Alice Chen adopted a cat named Mochi from a local shelter last spring.
Alice Chen has been rock climbing since age 14.
Alice Chen and Bob Martinez have been roommates since freshman year.
Alice Chen is interning at a robotics startup called AutoMind this summer.
Alice Chen's favorite programming language is Rust.
Alice Chen grew up in Portland, Oregon.
Alice Chen's parents run a Chinese restaurant called Golden Dragon in Portland.
Alice Chen plays acoustic guitar and learned from her grandfather.
Alice Chen won first place in a campus hackathon last November with a sign-language recognition app.
Alice Chen is training for a half-marathon in October.
Alice Chen visited Tokyo with her family during winter break 2023.
Alice Chen's favorite book is 'The Design of Everyday Things' by Don Norman.
Alice Chen volunteers at a coding workshop for high school students every Saturday.
Alice Chen broke her wrist while bouldering last March and had to wear a cast for six weeks.
Alice Chen's grandmother taught her to make xiaolongbao from scratch.
Alice Chen drives a blue 2018 Honda Civic.
Alice Chen is applying to graduate programs in human-computer interaction.
Alice Chen met Eve Park at a summer coding camp when they were both 15.
Alice Chen's favorite climbing route is at Smith Rock in central Oregon.
Alice Chen organized a fundraiser bake sale for the animal shelter where she adopted Mochi.

people.name: Bob Martinez
people.profile: Creative, easygoing, plays multiple instruments. From San Diego. Dreams of becoming a film composer.

observations.text: Bob Martinez plays drums in a campus band called The Wavelengths.
Bob Martinez works part-time as a barista at Crema Coffee on campus.
Bob Martinez grew up in San Diego, California.
Bob Martinez is studying music composition with a focus on film scoring.
Bob Martinez and Alice Chen have been roommates since freshman year.
Bob Martinez started dating Carol Kim after they met at a jazz festival last June.
Bob Martinez traveled to Vienna last summer to attend a film music workshop.
Bob Martinez's favorite film composer is Hans Zimmer.
Bob Martinez has a younger sister named Sofia who is in high school.
Bob Martinez composed the soundtrack for a student short film that won a regional award.
Bob Martinez can play piano, drums, and bass guitar.
Bob Martinez's favorite coffee drink to make is a cortado.
Bob Martinez adopted a goldfish named Beethoven.
Bob Martinez volunteers as a music tutor for underprivileged kids on weekends.
Bob Martinez is saving up to buy a vintage Fender Rhodes keyboard.
Bob Martinez ran a 10K charity race for music education last month.
Bob Martinez's mother is a high school music teacher in San Diego.
Bob Martinez has a tattoo of a treble clef on his left wrist.
Bob Martinez's band The Wavelengths just got invited to play at the Spring Music Festival.
Bob Martinez is considering applying to the Berklee College of Music for a master's degree.

people.name: Carol Kim
people.profile: Driven and compassionate. Korean-American, from Seattle. Passionate about global health.

observations.text: Carol Kim is a pre-med student focusing on global health.
Carol Kim volunteers at the campus health clinic every Tuesday and Thursday.
Carol Kim grew up in Seattle, Washington.
Carol Kim and David Okafor are lab partners in their organic chemistry class.
Carol Kim traveled to Ghana last summer for a medical volunteer program.
Carol Kim started dating Bob Martinez after they met at a jazz festival last June.
Carol Kim runs every morning at 6 AM, usually 5 kilometers.
Carol Kim's favorite cuisine is Korean food, especially her mom's kimchi jjigae.
Carol Kim has a younger brother named Daniel who just started college.
Carol Kim is studying for the MCAT exam scheduled for September.
Carol Kim organized a campus blood drive that collected 200 donations.
Carol Kim's dream is to work with Doctors Without Borders after medical school.
Carol Kim adopted a hamster named Tofu from the biology department.
Carol Kim speaks Korean and English fluently, and is learning Spanish.
Carol Kim won the university's community service award last spring.
Carol Kim's favorite book is 'Mountains Beyond Mountains' by Tracy Kidder.
Carol Kim taught herself to knit during the pandemic and made scarves for the homeless shelter.
Carol Kim takes a ballet class on Wednesday evenings for stress relief.
Carol Kim's parents own a small bakery called Kim's Pastries in Seattle.
Carol Kim is planning a study group trip to South Korea next winter break.

people.name: David Okafor
people.profile: Disciplined and ambitious. Nigerian-American, from Chicago. Competitive athlete with a calm demeanor.

observations.text: David Okafor ran the Chicago Marathon last October with a time of 3 hours 15 minutes.
David Okafor works part-time as a barista at the same coffee shop as Bob Martinez.
David Okafor grew up in Chicago, Illinois.
David Okafor and Carol Kim are lab partners in organic chemistry.
David Okafor is training for the Boston Marathon qualifying time.
David Okafor and Eve Park work together at the campus tutoring center.
David Okafor's father is a professor of pharmacology at the University of Chicago.
David Okafor has a pet turtle named Newton.
David Okafor's favorite food is his grandmother's jollof rice.
David Okafor won a biochemistry research award for his work on protein folding.
David Okafor speaks English, Igbo, and basic French.
David Okafor volunteers as a running coach for a youth track program on Saturdays.
David Okafor visited Lagos, Nigeria last summer to see his extended family.
David Okafor's favorite book is 'The Emperor of All Maladies' by Siddhartha Mukherjee.
David Okafor is applying to MD-PhD programs for next year.
David Okafor built a standing desk from reclaimed wood for his dorm room.
David Okafor's morning routine includes a 10K run at 5:30 AM.
David Okafor organized a campus 5K fundraiser for sickle cell research.
David Okafor drives a red 2020 Toyota Corolla.
David Okafor taught himself to cook Nigerian dishes during his first semester away from home.

people.name: Eve Park
people.role: Environmental science major, campus sustainability coordinator
people.profile: Passionate environmentalist, artistic. Korean-American, from Portland. Alice's childhood friend.

observations.text: Eve Park is the campus sustainability coordinator and organized a zero-waste week.
Eve Park grew up in Portland, Oregon, in the same neighborhood as Alice Chen.
Eve Park and Alice Chen met at a summer coding camp when they were both 15.
Eve Park and David Okafor work together at the campus tutoring center.
Eve Park has a rescue dog named Maple who she adopted during sophomore year.
Eve Park paints watercolor landscapes and sells them at the campus art fair.
Eve Park spent a semester abroad in Costa Rica studying tropical ecology.
Eve Park is vegetarian and loves cooking Thai food.
Eve Park's favorite hiking trail is Eagle Creek Trail near Portland.
Eve Park plays the ukulele and performs at open mic nights.
Eve Park is writing her senior thesis on urban composting systems.
Eve Park's mother is a landscape architect.
Eve Park won a grant from the EPA for a campus garden project.
Eve Park taught a workshop on making beeswax food wraps last month.
Eve Park's favorite book is 'Braiding Sweetgrass' by Robin Wall Kimmerer.
Eve Park drives a white 2019 Prius that she calls 'Cloud'.
Eve Park volunteers at a community garden near campus every Sunday.
Eve Park is planning to apply for a Peace Corps position after graduation.
Eve Park took a pottery class with Carol Kim last semester.
Eve Park's father owns a small bookstore called Park's Pages in Portland.
